description: Canonical JSON (RFC 8785) with non-ASCII member names. The expected text follows RFC 8785 Section 3.2.3: members sorted by UTF-16 code units. decision_id is computed over this form, so both implementations must produce these bytes exactly.

vectors.name: rfc8785-3.2.3-sorting
vectors.source: RFC 8785, Section 3.2.3: the sorting example, expected order as printed in the RFC
vectors.input: {"\u20ac":"Euro Sign","\r":"Carriage Return","\ufb33":"Hebrew Letter Dalet With Dagesh","1":"One","\ud83d\ude00":"Emoji: Grinning Face","\u0080":"Control","\u00f6":"Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis"}
vectors.expected: {"\r":"Carriage Return","1":"One","":"Control","ö":"Latin Small Letter O With Diaeresis","€":"Euro Sign","😀":"Emoji: Grinning Face","דּ":"Hebrew Letter Dalet With Dagesh"}

vectors.name: utf16-vs-codepoint
vectors.source: U+FF61 and U+1D11E: code point order puts U+FF61 first, UTF-16 code unit order (RFC 8785) puts U+1D11E (D834 DD1E) first

vectors.name: nested-non-ascii
vectors.source: the same rule at depth 2, next to ASCII names
